g.text: Frozen visual backbone · Causal force histories · Transformer fusion
The final query can attend to
Shapes omit batch dimension. Only CLIP is frozen; projection, CNNs, embeddings, query and Transformer are trained.
F/T: force and torque. Mean window = 5; mean-difference lag = 5. Residual-path dropout omitted for clarity.
